{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_patients = data[data['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check how many SEVERE patients there are
print("Number of SEVERE patients:", len(severe_patients))

# Check for sentinel values (-999.0) in biomarker_baseline for SEVERE patients
severe_with_sentinel = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]
print("Number of SEVERE patients with sentinel value -999.0:", len(severe_with_sentinel))

# Remove sentinel values for SEVERE patients
severe_valid = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for valid SEVERE patients
mean_biomarker = severe_valid['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print("Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL) for SEVERE patients (excluding sentinel values):", mean_biomarker)"}
